title: agentfleet ls --json
description: The Fleet listing agentfleet ls --json prints: one entry per labelled container (running and stopped), Compose one-off containers excluded, duplicate instance names flagged rather than hidden (spec section 2.1).

name.description: The instance name from the discovery labels (spec section 2.1).

backend.description: The engine implementation behind the instance; display only.

contract.description: The contract major from the discovery label.

state.description: The container state from docker inspect (e.g. running, exited).

duplicate.description: True when more than one container carries this instance name.
